WITH volume_surge AS (
    SELECT symbol, stock_name, close, change_rate, volume, avg_volume_20d, market_cap
    FROM kr_intraday
    WHERE volume > avg_volume_20d * 2 AND avg_volume_20d > 0
),
with_grade AS (
    SELECT vs.symbol, vs.stock_name, vs.close, vs.change_rate,
           vs.volume, vs.avg_volume_20d, vs.market_cap,
           g.final_grade, g.final_score, g.foreign_net_30d
    FROM volume_surge vs
    JOIN kr_stock_grade g ON vs.symbol = g.symbol
    WHERE g.final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수', '매수 고려')
      AND g.foreign_net_30d > 0
)
SELECT symbol, stock_name, close, change_rate, volume, avg_volume_20d,
       market_cap, final_grade, final_score, foreign_net_30d
FROM with_grade
ORDER BY final_score DESC

WITH volume_compare AS (
    SELECT
        symbol, date, volume,
        LAG(volume) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) as prev_volume
    FROM kr_intraday_total
    WHERE date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 days'
)
SELECT k.symbol, k.stock_name, k.close, k.volume,
       vc.prev_volume,
       ROUND(k.volume::numeric / NULLIF(vc.prev_volume, 0), 2) as volume_ratio
FROM kr_intraday k
JOIN volume_compare vc ON k.symbol = vc.symbol
WHERE vc.date = CURRENT_DATE
  AND vc.prev_volume > 0
  AND k.volume >= vc.prev_volume * 2
ORDER BY volume_ratio DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH foreign_consecutive AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    date,
    foreign_net_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date DESC) as rn,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE foreign_net_value > 0) OVER (
      PARTITION BY symbol 
      ORDER BY date DESC 
      ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 4 FOLLOWING
    ) as consecutive_buy_days
  FROM kr_individual_investor_daily_trading
  WHERE date >= (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '10 days' FROM kr_individual_investor_daily_trading)
),
latest_data AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) as max_date FROM kr_intraday_total
),
qualified_stocks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fc.symbol
  FROM foreign_consecutive fc
  WHERE fc.rn <= 5 
    AND fc.consecutive_buy_days = 5
    AND fc.foreign_net_value > 0
)
SELECT 
  kit.symbol,
  kit.stock_name,
  kit.close,
  kit.change_rate,
  ki.rsi,
  ki.real_lower_band,
  kit.close / ki.real_lower_band as price_to_lower_band_ratio,
  SUM(kii.foreign_net_value) OVER (
    PARTITION BY kit.symbol 
    ORDER BY kit.date 
    ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) as foreign_net_5d,
  kit.per,
  kit.pbr
FROM qualified_stocks qs

WHERE kit.date = ld.max_date

WITH latest_date AS (

),
investor_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,

  FROM kr_individual_investor_daily_trading kii

  WHERE kii.date >= ld.max_date - INTERVAL '19 days'
    AND kii.date <= ld.max_date
  GROUP BY symbol
  HAVING SUM(inst_net_value) > 0

),
macd_signals AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    date,
    macd,
    macd_signal,

    LAG(macd_signal, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) as prev_macd_signal
  FROM kr_indicators
),
golden_cross AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT symbol
  FROM macd_signals ms
  CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
  WHERE ms.date >= ld.max_date - INTERVAL '5 days'

    AND ms.prev_macd <= ms.prev_macd_signal
    AND ms.macd > ms.macd_signal

  kit.change_rate,

    WHEN kit.market_cap >= 1000000000000 THEN '중형주'
    ELSE '소형주'

  AND kit.avg_volume_20d > 0
ORDER BY (kit.volume::numeric / NULLIF(kit.avg_volume_20d, 0)) DESC, isum.both_buy_days DESC;

WITH latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) as max_date FROM kr_individual_investor_daily_trading
),
smart_money_flow AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    SUM(retail_net_value) as retail_net_30d,
    SUM(inst_net_value) as inst_net_30d,
    SUM(foreign_net_value) as foreign_net_30d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inst_net_value > 0) as inst_buy_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE foreign_net_value > 0) as foreign_buy_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE retail_net_value < 0) as retail_sell_days,
    AVG(inst_net_value) as avg_inst_flow,
    AVG(foreign_net_value) as avg_foreign_flow
  FROM kr_individual_investor_daily_trading
  CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
  WHERE date >= ld.max_date - INTERVAL '29 days'
    AND date <= ld.max_date
  GROUP BY symbol
  HAVING SUM(retail_net_value) < 0
    AND SUM(inst_net_value) > 0 
    AND SUM(foreign_net_value) > 0
    AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inst_net_value > 0) >= 15
    AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE foreign_net_value > 0) >= 12
),
bb_consolidation AS (
  SELECT 
    kit.symbol,
    kit.stock_name,
    kit.close,
    ki.real_middle_band,
    ki.rsi,
    ABS((kit.close / ki.real_middle_band) - 1) as distance_from_middle_pct,
    STDDEV(kit.close) OVER (
      PARTITION BY kit.symbol 
      ORDER BY kit.date 
      ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) / AVG(kit.close) OVER (
      PARTITION BY kit.symbol 
      ORDER BY kit.date 
      ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as price_volatility_10d
  FROM kr_intraday_total kit
  JOIN kr_indicators ki ON kit.symbol = ki.symbol AND kit.date = ki.date
  CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
  WHERE kit.date = ld.max_date
    AND ki.rsi <= 50
    AND ki.real_middle_band > 0
)
SELECT 
  bc.symbol,
  bc.stock_name,
  bc.close,
  kit.change_rate,
  bc.rsi,
  bc.real_middle_band,
  ROUND(bc.distance_from_middle_pct * 100, 2) as distance_from_middle_pct,
  ROUND(bc.price_volatility_10d * 100, 2) as volatility_10d_pct,
  smf.retail_net_30d,
  smf.inst_net_30d,
  smf.foreign_net_30d,
  smf.inst_buy_days,
  smf.foreign_buy_days,
  smf.retail_sell_days,
  kit.volume,
  kit.avg_volume_20d,
  CASE 
    WHEN kit.avg_volume_20d > 0 
    THEN ROUND((kit.volume::numeric / kit.avg_volume_20d) * 100, 1)
    ELSE NULL 
  END as volume_ratio_pct,
  kit.market_cap
FROM smart_money_flow smf
JOIN bb_consolidation bc ON smf.symbol = bc.symbol
JOIN kr_intraday_total kit ON bc.symbol = kit.symbol
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE kit.date = ld.max_date
  AND bc.distance_from_middle_pct <= 0.03
  AND bc.price_volatility_10d <= 0.05
  AND ABS(smf.inst_net_30d) >= 1000000000
ORDER BY smf.inst_net_30d + smf.foreign_net_30d DESC, bc.distance_from_middle_pct ASC;

    MAX(i.date) as max_indicator_date,
    MAX(e.estimate_date) as max_estimate_date,

  FROM us_daily d, us_indicators i, us_earnings_estimates e, us_stock_grade g

  SELECT 
    e.symbol,
    b.stock_name,
    b.sector,

    b.analysttargetprice

  JOIN us_stock_basic b ON e.symbol = b.symbol
  CROSS JOIN latest_dates ld
  WHERE e.estimate_date = ld.max_estimate_date
    AND b.sector IN ('Technology', 'Information Technology')
    AND e.eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days > e.eps_estimate_revision_down_trailing_30_days
    AND e.eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days > 0

FROM tech_stocks_with_upward_revisions ts
JOIN us_daily d ON ts.symbol = d.symbol
JOIN us_indicators i ON ts.symbol = i.symbol AND d.date = i.date

  SELECT

    MAX(inc.fiscal_date_ending) as max_income_date

strong_cashflow_companies AS (
  SELECT 
    cf.symbol,
    cf.operating_cashflow,
    inc.net_income,

      WHEN inc.net_income > 0 THEN (cf.operating_cashflow::NUMERIC / inc.net_income::NUMERIC) * 100
      ELSE NULL
    END as ocf_to_ni_ratio
  FROM us_cash_flow cf
  JOIN us_income_statement inc ON cf.symbol = inc.symbol AND cf.fiscal_date_ending = inc.fiscal_date_ending
  CROSS JOIN latest_dates ld
  WHERE cf.fiscal_date_ending = ld.max_cashflow_date
    AND inc.fiscal_date_ending = ld.max_income_date
    AND cf.operating_cashflow > 0
    AND inc.net_income > 0
    AND (cf.operating_cashflow::NUMERIC / inc.net_income::NUMERIC) >= 1.2
),
macd_signals AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    date,
    macd,
    macd_signal,
    LAG(macd, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) as prev_macd,
    LAG(macd_signal, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) as prev_macd_signal,
    CASE 
      WHEN macd > macd_signal AND LAG(macd, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) <= LAG(macd_signal, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date)
      THEN true
      ELSE false
    END as golden_cross
  FROM us_indicators
  WHERE macd IS NOT NULL AND macd_signal IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  d.symbol,
  b.stock_name,
  b.sector,
  d.close as current_price,
  d.volume,
  d.avg_volume_20d,
  ROUND((d.volume::NUMERIC / d.avg_volume_20d::NUMERIC), 2) as volume_ratio,
  i.macd,

  AND b.market_cap >= 500000000

WITH latest_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(d.date) as max_daily_date,
    MAX(g.date) as max_grade_date,
    MAX(bal.fiscal_date_ending) as max_balance_date
  FROM us_daily d, us_stock_grade g, us_balance_sheet bal
),
financially_healthy_companies AS (
  SELECT 
    b.symbol,
    b.stock_name,
    b.returnonequityttm as roe,
    bal.total_liabilities,
    bal.total_assets,
    CASE 
      WHEN bal.total_assets > 0 THEN (bal.total_liabilities::NUMERIC / bal.total_assets::NUMERIC) * 100
      ELSE NULL 
    END as debt_ratio,
    b.analysttargetprice,
    b.sector,
    b.market_cap
  FROM us_stock_basic b
  JOIN us_balance_sheet bal ON b.symbol = bal.symbol
  CROSS JOIN latest_dates ld
  WHERE bal.fiscal_date_ending = ld.max_balance_date
    AND b.returnonequityttm >= 15.0
    AND bal.total_assets > 0
    AND (bal.total_liabilities::NUMERIC / bal.total_assets::NUMERIC) <= 0.4
    AND b.analysttargetprice IS NOT NULL
),
target_price_changes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    symbol
  FROM us_stock_basic
  WHERE analysttargetprice IS NOT NULL
    AND updated_at >= (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM us_stock_basic) - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT 
  fhc.symbol,
  fhc.stock_name,
  fhc.sector,
  d.close as current_price,
  fhc.analysttargetprice as target_price,
  ROUND(((fhc.analysttargetprice - d.close) / d.close * 100), 2) as upside_potential_pct,
  g.final_grade,
  g.final_score,
  ROUND(fhc.roe, 2) as roe,
  ROUND(fhc.debt_ratio, 2) as debt_ratio,
  g.var_95 as daily_var_95_pct,
  g.volatility_annual,
  g.max_drawdown_1y,
  g.sharpe_ratio,
  g.risk_reward_ratio,
  CASE 
    WHEN g.var_95 IS NOT NULL AND g.var_95 != 0 
    THEN ROUND((((fhc.analysttargetprice - d.close) / d.close * 100) / ABS(g.var_95)), 2)
    ELSE NULL 
  END as risk_adjusted_return,
  g.beta,
  fhc.market_cap / 1000000000 as market_cap_billions,
  g.conviction_score,
  g.entry_timing_score
FROM financially_healthy_companies fhc
JOIN us_daily d ON fhc.symbol = d.symbol
JOIN us_stock_grade g ON fhc.symbol = g.symbol AND d.date = g.date
JOIN target_price_changes tpc ON fhc.symbol = tpc.symbol
CROSS JOIN latest_dates ld
WHERE d.date = ld.max_daily_date
  AND g.date = ld.max_grade_date
  AND g.final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수')
  AND fhc.analysttargetprice > d.close
  AND g.var_95 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY risk_adjusted_return DESC NULLS LAST, g.conviction_score DESC

WITH option_volume_baseline AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    AVG(total_call_volume + total_put_volume) as avg_total_volume,
    AVG(total_put_volume::NUMERIC / NULLIF(total_call_volume, 0)) as avg_put_call_ratio,
    STDDEV(total_put_volume::NUMERIC / NULLIF(total_call_volume, 0)) as pc_ratio_stddev
  FROM us_option_daily_summary
  WHERE date >= (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '30 days' FROM us_option_daily_summary)
    AND date < (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '3 days' FROM us_option_daily_summary)
  GROUP BY symbol
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
),
recent_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    uods.symbol,
    uods.date,
    uods.total_call_volume + uods.total_put_volume as current_total_volume,
    uods.total_put_volume::NUMERIC / NULLIF(uods.total_call_volume, 0) as current_pc_ratio,
    uods.net_gex,
    uods.gamma_flip_distance,
    uods.avg_implied_volatility,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uods.symbol ORDER BY uods.date DESC) as rn
  FROM us_option_daily_summary uods
  WHERE uods.date >= (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '3 days' FROM us_option_daily_summary)
),
anomalous_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    ra.symbol,
    ra.date,
    ra.current_total_volume,
    ovb.avg_total_volume,
    ROUND(ra.current_total_volume / ovb.avg_total_volume, 2) as volume_multiple,
    ra.current_pc_ratio,
    ovb.avg_put_call_ratio,
    CASE 
      WHEN ovb.pc_ratio_stddev > 0 THEN ABS(ra.current_pc_ratio - ovb.avg_put_call_ratio) / ovb.pc_ratio_stddev
      ELSE 0
    END as pc_ratio_z_score,
    ra.net_gex,
    ra.gamma_flip_distance,
    ra.avg_implied_volatility
  FROM recent_activity ra
  JOIN option_volume_baseline ovb ON ra.symbol = ovb.symbol
  WHERE ra.rn = 1
    AND ra.current_total_volume >= ovb.avg_total_volume * 5
    AND (ra.current_pc_ratio >= ovb.avg_put_call_ratio * 2 OR ra.current_pc_ratio <= ovb.avg_put_call_ratio * 0.5)
)
SELECT 
  aa.symbol,
  usb.stock_name,
  usb.sector,
  aa.date,
  aa.current_total_volume,
  ROUND(aa.avg_total_volume) as avg_volume_30d,
  aa.volume_multiple,
  ROUND(aa.current_pc_ratio, 3) as current_put_call_ratio,
  ROUND(aa.avg_put_call_ratio, 3) as avg_put_call_ratio_30d,
  ROUND(aa.pc_ratio_z_score, 2) as pc_ratio_zscore,
  ROUND(aa.net_gex / 1000000, 2) as net_gex_millions,
  ROUND(aa.gamma_flip_distance, 2) as gamma_flip_distance,
  ROUND(aa.avg_implied_volatility * 100, 1) as implied_vol_pct,
  ud.close as stock_price,

FROM anomalous_activity aa
JOIN us_stock_basic usb ON aa.symbol = usb.symbol
LEFT JOIN us_daily ud ON aa.symbol = ud.symbol AND aa.date = ud.date
WHERE usb.market_cap > 500000000
ORDER BY aa.volume_multiple DESC, aa.pc_ratio_z_score DESC

WITH sector_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    usb.sector,
    COUNT(*) as sector_stock_count,
    AVG(ud.close) as avg_sector_price,
    AVG(ud.change_rate) as avg_sector_performance
  FROM us_stock_basic usb
  JOIN us_daily ud ON usb.symbol = ud.symbol
  WHERE ud.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM us_daily)
    AND usb.sector IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY usb.sector
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
),
bollinger_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ui.symbol,
    ui.date,
    ui.real_lower_band,
    ui.real_middle_band,
    ui.real_upper_band,
    ud.close,
    ud.low,
    (ud.close - ui.real_lower_band) / (ui.real_upper_band - ui.real_lower_band) as bb_position,
    (ud.low - ui.real_lower_band) / ui.real_lower_band * 100 as distance_to_lower_band,
    ud.volume,
    ud.avg_volume_20d,
    ud.change_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ui.symbol ORDER BY ui.date DESC) as rn
  FROM us_indicators ui
  JOIN us_daily ud ON ui.symbol = ud.symbol AND ui.date = ud.date
  WHERE ui.date >= (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '5 days' FROM us_indicators)
    AND ui.real_lower_band IS NOT NULL
    AND ui.real_upper_band IS NOT NULL
),
volume_surge_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ud.symbol,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ud.date >= (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '3 days' FROM us_daily) THEN ud.volume END) as avg_volume_3d,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ud.date >= (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '30 days' FROM us_daily) AND ud.date < (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '7 days' FROM us_daily) THEN ud.volume END) as avg_volume_baseline,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ud.date >= (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '7 days' FROM us_daily) AND ud.change_rate > 0 THEN 1 END) as positive_days_7d
  FROM us_daily ud
  WHERE ud.date >= (SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '30 days' FROM us_daily)
  GROUP BY ud.symbol
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
),
analyst_targets AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    analysttargetprice,
    analystratingstrongbuy + analystratingbuy as total_buy_ratings,
    analystratingstrongbuy + analystratingbuy + analystratinghold + analystratingsell + analystratingstrongsell as total_ratings
  FROM us_stock_basic
  WHERE analysttargetprice > 0
    AND (analystratingstrongbuy + analystratingbuy + analystratinghold + analystratingsell + analystratingstrongsell) >= 5
)
SELECT 
  ba.symbol,
  usb.stock_name,
  usb.sector,
  ROUND(ba.close, 2) as current_price,
  ROUND(ba.real_lower_band, 2) as bb_lower_band,
  ROUND(ba.bb_position * 100, 1) as bb_position_pct,
  ROUND(ba.distance_to_lower_band, 2) as distance_to_lower_pct,
  ROUND(ba.change_rate, 2) as daily_change_pct,
  ROUND(vsa.avg_volume_3d / vsa.avg_volume_baseline, 2) as volume_surge_ratio,
  vsa.positive_days_7d,
  ROUND(at.analysttargetprice, 2) as analyst_target,
  ROUND((at.analysttargetprice - ba.close) / ba.close * 100, 2) as upside_to_target_pct,
  at.total_buy_ratings,
  at.total_ratings,
  ROUND(at.total_buy_ratings::NUMERIC / at.total_ratings * 100, 1) as buy_rating_pct,
  ROUND(usb.market_cap / 1000000000, 1) as market_cap_bn
FROM bollinger_analysis ba
JOIN volume_surge_analysis vsa ON ba.symbol = vsa.symbol
JOIN analyst_targets at ON ba.symbol = at.symbol
JOIN us_stock_basic usb ON ba.symbol = usb.symbol
JOIN sector_analysis sa ON usb.sector = sa.sector
WHERE ba.rn = 1
  AND ba.bb_position <= 0.25
  AND ba.distance_to_lower_band >= -5
  AND ba.change_rate > 0
  AND vsa.avg_volume_3d >= vsa.avg_volume_baseline * 1.5
  AND vsa.positive_days_7d >= 3
  AND (at.analysttargetprice - ba.close) / ba.close >= 0.10
  AND usb.market_cap > 500000000
ORDER BY upside_to_target_pct DESC, volume_surge_ratio DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH latest_estimates AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(estimate_date) as max_date
  FROM us_earnings_estimates
  WHERE horizon = 'next fiscal year'
  GROUP BY symbol
),
eps_trend AS (
  SELECT 
    e.symbol,
    e.eps_estimate_average as current_eps,
    e.eps_estimate_average_30_days_ago as eps_30d_ago,
    e.eps_estimate_average_60_days_ago as eps_60d_ago,
    e.eps_estimate_average_90_days_ago as eps_90d_ago,
    CASE 
      WHEN e.eps_estimate_average > e.eps_estimate_average_30_days_ago 
       AND e.eps_estimate_average_30_days_ago > e.eps_estimate_average_60_days_ago
       AND e.eps_estimate_average_60_days_ago > e.eps_estimate_average_90_days_ago
      THEN true ELSE false 
    END as improving_trend,
    (e.eps_estimate_average - e.eps_estimate_average_90_days_ago) / NULLIF(ABS(e.eps_estimate_average_90_days_ago), 0) * 100 as eps_improvement_pct
  FROM us_earnings_estimates e
  JOIN latest_estimates le ON e.symbol = le.symbol AND e.estimate_date = le.max_date
  WHERE e.eps_estimate_average_90_days_ago IS NOT NULL
),
latest_price AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_daily
  GROUP BY symbol
),
stock_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    et.symbol,
    b.stock_name,
    b.sector,
    ud.close as current_price,
    b.analysttargetprice as target_price,
    et.current_eps,
    et.eps_improvement_pct,
    (b.analysttargetprice - ud.close) / NULLIF(ud.close, 0) * 100 as upside_potential,
    b.analystratingstrongbuy + b.analystratingbuy as buy_ratings,
    b.analystratingstrongbuy + b.analystratingbuy + b.analystratinghold + b.analystratingsell + b.analystratingstrongsell as total_ratings
  FROM eps_trend et
  JOIN us_stock_basic b ON et.symbol = b.symbol
  JOIN latest_price lp ON et.symbol = lp.symbol
  JOIN us_daily ud ON et.symbol = ud.symbol AND lp.max_date = ud.date
  WHERE et.improving_trend = true
    AND b.analysttargetprice IS NOT NULL
    AND b.analysttargetprice > ud.close
    AND et.eps_improvement_pct > 5
)
SELECT 
  symbol,
  stock_name,
  sector,
  current_price,
  target_price,
  ROUND(upside_potential, 2) as upside_potential_pct,
  ROUND(eps_improvement_pct, 2) as eps_improvement_pct,
  current_eps,
  ROUND(buy_ratings::numeric / NULLIF(total_ratings, 0) * 100, 1) as buy_ratio_pct
FROM stock_analysis
ORDER BY upside_potential DESC, eps_improvement_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH option_volume_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    date,
    total_call_volume,
    total_put_volume,
    total_call_volume + total_put_volume as total_volume,
    LAG(total_call_volume + total_put_volume, 5) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) as volume_5d_ago,
    LAG(total_call_volume + total_put_volume, 10) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) as volume_10d_ago,
    total_call_volume::numeric / NULLIF(total_call_volume + total_put_volume, 0) * 100 as call_ratio
  FROM us_option_daily_summary
  WHERE total_call_volume > 0 AND total_put_volume > 0
),
latest_option_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_option_daily_summary
  GROUP BY symbol
),
rsi_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    date,
    rsi,
    LAG(rsi, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) as rsi_prev,
    LAG(rsi, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) as rsi_2d_ago,
    CASE 
      WHEN rsi < 35 AND LAG(rsi, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) < rsi 
       AND LAG(rsi, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) < 30
      THEN true ELSE false
    END as oversold_recovery
  FROM us_indicators
),
latest_indicator_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_indicators
  GROUP BY symbol
),
latest_price_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_daily
  GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT 
  ova.symbol,
  b.stock_name,
  b.sector,
  ud.close as current_price,
  ud.volume as stock_volume,
  ova.total_volume as option_volume,
  ROUND(ova.call_ratio, 1) as call_ratio_pct,
  ROUND(ova.total_volume::numeric / NULLIF((ova.volume_5d_ago + ova.volume_10d_ago) / 2.0, 0), 2) as volume_spike_ratio,
  ROUND(ra.rsi, 1) as current_rsi,
  ROUND(ra.rsi_prev, 1) as prev_rsi,
  ud.change_rate as daily_change_pct,
  ops.avg_implied_volatility as avg_iv
FROM option_volume_analysis ova
JOIN latest_option_date lod ON ova.symbol = lod.symbol AND ova.date = lod.max_date
JOIN rsi_analysis ra ON ova.symbol = ra.symbol
JOIN latest_indicator_date lid ON ra.symbol = lid.symbol AND ra.date = lid.max_date
JOIN us_stock_basic b ON ova.symbol = b.symbol
JOIN latest_price_date lpd ON ova.symbol = lpd.symbol
JOIN us_daily ud ON ova.symbol = ud.symbol AND lpd.max_date = ud.date
JOIN us_option_daily_summary ops ON ova.symbol = ops.symbol AND ova.date = ops.date
WHERE ova.call_ratio >= 70
  AND ova.total_volume::numeric / NULLIF((ova.volume_5d_ago + ova.volume_10d_ago) / 2.0, 0) >= 3
  AND ra.oversold_recovery = true
  AND ova.total_volume > 1000
ORDER BY ova.total_volume::numeric / NULLIF((ova.volume_5d_ago + ova.volume_10d_ago) / 2.0, 0) DESC;

WITH latest_grade_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_stock_grade
  GROUP BY symbol
),
latest_price_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_daily
  GROUP BY symbol
),
balanced_stocks AS (
  SELECT 
    g.symbol,
    g.stock_name,
    g.final_grade,
    g.final_score,
    g.value_score,
    g.quality_score,
    g.momentum_score,
    g.growth_score,
    g.confidence_score,
    g.beta,
    g.volatility_annual,
    g.max_drawdown_1y,
    g.sharpe_ratio,
    g.var_95,
    g.sector_percentile,
    g.industry_percentile,
    CASE 
      WHEN g.value_score >= 70 AND g.quality_score >= 70 
       AND g.momentum_score >= 70 AND g.growth_score >= 70 
      THEN true ELSE false
    END as all_factors_strong,
    (g.value_score + g.quality_score + g.momentum_score + g.growth_score) / 4.0 as avg_factor_score,
    LEAST(g.value_score, g.quality_score, g.momentum_score, g.growth_score) as min_factor_score
  FROM us_stock_grade g
  JOIN latest_grade_date lgd ON g.symbol = lgd.symbol AND g.date = lgd.max_date
  WHERE g.final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수')
    AND g.value_score >= 70
    AND g.quality_score >= 70
    AND g.momentum_score >= 70
    AND g.growth_score >= 70
    AND g.beta <= 1.5
    AND g.beta IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  bs.symbol,
  bs.stock_name,
  b.sector,
  b.industry,
  ud.close as current_price,
  bs.final_grade,
  bs.final_score,
  bs.value_score,
  bs.quality_score,
  bs.momentum_score,
  bs.growth_score,
  ROUND(bs.avg_factor_score, 1) as avg_factor_score,
  bs.min_factor_score,
  ROUND(bs.beta, 2) as beta,
  ROUND(bs.volatility_annual, 1) as annual_volatility_pct,
  ROUND(bs.max_drawdown_1y, 1) as max_drawdown_1y_pct,
  ROUND(bs.sharpe_ratio, 2) as sharpe_ratio,
  ROUND(bs.sector_percentile, 1) as sector_percentile,

  ROUND(ud.change_rate, 2) as daily_change_pct
FROM balanced_stocks bs
JOIN us_stock_basic b ON bs.symbol = b.symbol
JOIN latest_price_date lpd ON bs.symbol = lpd.symbol
JOIN us_daily ud ON bs.symbol = ud.symbol AND lpd.max_date = ud.date
WHERE bs.all_factors_strong = true
ORDER BY bs.final_score DESC, bs.min_factor_score DESC, bs.beta ASC

WITH latest_estimates_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(estimate_date) as max_date
  FROM us_earnings_estimates
  WHERE horizon = 'next fiscal year'
  GROUP BY symbol
),
analyst_revisions AS (
  SELECT 
    e.symbol,
    e.eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days as up_revisions_30d,
    e.eps_estimate_revision_down_trailing_30_days as down_revisions_30d,
    e.eps_estimate_average as current_eps_est,
    e.eps_estimate_analyst_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN e.eps_estimate_revision_down_trailing_30_days > 0 
      THEN e.eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days::numeric / e.eps_estimate_revision_down_trailing_30_days
      ELSE 999 
    END as revision_ratio
  FROM us_earnings_estimates e
  JOIN latest_estimates_date led ON e.symbol = led.symbol AND e.estimate_date = led.max_date
  WHERE e.eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days >= 3 * e.eps_estimate_revision_down_trailing_30_days
    AND e.eps_estimate_revision_up_trailing_30_days > 0
),
latest_price_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_daily
  GROUP BY symbol
),
latest_indicator_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_indicators
  GROUP BY symbol
),
macd_golden_cross AS (
  SELECT 
    i.symbol,
    i.date,
    i.macd,
    i.macd_signal,
    LAG(i.macd, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i.symbol ORDER BY i.date) as prev_macd,
    LAG(i.macd_signal, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i.symbol ORDER BY i.date) as prev_macd_signal,
    CASE 
      WHEN i.macd > i.macd_signal 
       AND LAG(i.macd, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i.symbol ORDER BY i.date) <= LAG(i.macd_signal, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i.symbol ORDER BY i.date)
      THEN true ELSE false
    END as golden_cross
  FROM us_indicators i
  WHERE i.macd IS NOT NULL AND i.macd_signal IS NOT NULL
),
valuation_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ar.symbol,
    ar.up_revisions_30d,
    ar.down_revisions_30d,
    ar.revision_ratio,
    ar.current_eps_est,
    ar.eps_estimate_analyst_count,
    b.stock_name,
    b.sector,
    b.analysttargetprice as target_price,
    ud.close as current_price,
    (b.analysttargetprice - ud.close) / NULLIF(ud.close, 0) * 100 as undervaluation_pct,
    mgc.golden_cross,
    mgc.macd,
    mgc.macd_signal
  FROM analyst_revisions ar
  JOIN us_stock_basic b ON ar.symbol = b.symbol
  JOIN latest_price_date lpd ON ar.symbol = lpd.symbol
  JOIN us_daily ud ON ar.symbol = ud.symbol AND lpd.max_date = ud.date
  JOIN latest_indicator_date lid ON ar.symbol = lid.symbol
  JOIN macd_golden_cross mgc ON ar.symbol = mgc.symbol AND lid.max_date = mgc.date
  WHERE b.analysttargetprice IS NOT NULL
    AND (b.analysttargetprice - ud.close) / NULLIF(ud.close, 0) * 100 >= 20
    AND mgc.golden_cross = true
)
SELECT 
  symbol,
  stock_name,
  sector,

WITH latest_option_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_option_daily_summary
  GROUP BY symbol
),
latest_grade_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_stock_grade
  WHERE iv_percentile IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY symbol
),
latest_price_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_daily
  GROUP BY symbol
),
gamma_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ops.symbol,
    ops.net_gex,
    ops.call_gex,
    ops.put_gex,
    ops.total_put_volume::numeric / NULLIF(ops.total_call_volume, 0) as put_call_ratio,
    ops.avg_implied_volatility,
    ops.total_call_volume + ops.total_put_volume as total_option_volume,
    ABS(ops.net_gex) as abs_net_gex
  FROM us_option_daily_summary ops
  JOIN latest_option_date lod ON ops.symbol = lod.symbol AND ops.date = lod.max_date
  WHERE ops.net_gex < 0
    AND ops.total_call_volume > 0 
    AND ops.total_put_volume > 0
    AND ops.total_put_volume::numeric / NULLIF(ops.total_call_volume, 0) >= 1.5
),
risk_opportunity_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.symbol,
    b.stock_name,
    b.sector,
    ud.close as current_price,
    ud.volume as stock_volume,
    ud.change_rate as daily_change_pct,
    ga.net_gex,
    ga.abs_net_gex,
    ROUND(ga.put_call_ratio, 2) as put_call_ratio,
    ROUND(ga.avg_implied_volatility * 100, 1) as iv_pct,
    g.iv_percentile,
    ga.total_option_volume,
    g.volatility_annual,
    g.var_95,
    g.beta,
    g.final_grade,
    g.risk_flag,
    b.analysttargetprice,
    (b.analysttargetprice - ud.close) / NULLIF(ud.close, 0) * 100 as target_upside_pct,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ga.abs_net_gex DESC) as gex_rank
  FROM gamma_analysis ga
  JOIN us_stock_basic b ON ga.symbol = b.symbol
  JOIN latest_price_date lpd ON ga.symbol = lpd.symbol
  JOIN us_daily ud ON ga.symbol = ud.symbol AND lpd.max_date = ud.date
  LEFT JOIN latest_grade_date lgd ON ga.symbol = lgd.symbol
  LEFT JOIN us_stock_grade g ON ga.symbol = g.symbol AND lgd.max_date = g.date
  WHERE g.iv_percentile >= 90
    OR ga.avg_implied_volatility > 0.4
)
SELECT 
  symbol,
  stock_name,
  sector,
  current_price,
  daily_change_pct,
  ROUND(net_gex, 0) as net_gamma_exposure,
  put_call_ratio,
  iv_pct,
  COALESCE(iv_percentile, 99) as iv_percentile,
  total_option_volume,
  ROUND(COALESCE(volatility_annual, 0), 1) as annual_volatility_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(var_95, 0), 2) as daily_var_95_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(beta, 1), 2) as beta,
  COALESCE(final_grade, '정보없음') as investment_grade,
  COALESCE(risk_flag, 'UNKNOWN') as risk_level,
  COALESCE(analysttargetprice, current_price) as target_price,
  ROUND(COALESCE(target_upside_pct, 0), 1) as target_upside_pct,
  gex_rank,
  CASE 
    WHEN net_gex < -1000000 AND put_call_ratio > 2.0 THEN '극도위험-기회'
    WHEN net_gex < -500000 AND put_call_ratio > 1.8 THEN '고위험-기회'
    ELSE '중간위험-기회'
  END as risk_opportunity_level
FROM risk_opportunity_analysis
WHERE gex_rank <= 20
ORDER BY abs_net_gex DESC, put_call_ratio DESC
LIMIT 15;

연준 금리 인상 사이클(3개월 연속 금리 상승) 기간 동안 코스피와 나스닥의 상대적 성과를 비교하고, 한국 기준금리와의 스프레드 변화가 양국 증시에 미치는 영향을 분석하시오.

WITH fed_rate_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        date,
        value as fed_rate,
        LAG(value, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date) as prev_fed_rate,
        LAG(value, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date) as prev2_fed_rate,
        LAG(value, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date) as prev3_fed_rate
    FROM us_fed_funds_rate
    WHERE date >= '2020-01-01'
), rate_hike_cycles AS (
    SELECT date, fed_rate
    FROM fed_rate_changes
    WHERE fed_rate > prev_fed_rate 
      AND prev_fed_rate > prev2_fed_rate 
      AND prev2_fed_rate > prev3_fed_rate
), bok_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        time_value as date,
        data_value as bok_rate
    FROM bok_economic_indicators
    WHERE stat_name LIKE '%기준금리%' OR stat_name LIKE '%Base rate%'
      AND time_value >= '2020-01-01'
), market_performance AS (
    SELECT 
        mi.date,
        mi.exchange,
        mi.change_rate,
        mi.close,
        LAG(mi.close, 21) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.exchange ORDER BY mi.date) as close_1m_ago,
        LAG(mi.close, 63) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.exchange ORDER BY mi.date) as close_3m_ago,
        rhc.fed_rate,
        br.bok_rate,
        rhc.fed_rate - br.bok_rate as rate_spread
    FROM market_index mi
    INNER JOIN rate_hike_cycles rhc ON mi.date = rhc.date
    LEFT JOIN bok_rates br ON mi.date = br.date
    WHERE mi.exchange IN ('KOSPI', 'NASDAQ')
      AND mi.date >= '2020-01-01'
)
SELECT 
    mp.exchange,
    COUNT(*) as hike_cycle_days,
    AVG(mp.change_rate) as avg_daily_return,
    AVG((mp.close - mp.close_1m_ago) / mp.close_1m_ago * 100) as avg_1m_return,
    AVG((mp.close - mp.close_3m_ago) / mp.close_3m_ago * 100) as avg_3m_return,
    STDDEV(mp.change_rate) as daily_volatility,
    AVG(mp.rate_spread) as avg_rate_spread,
    CORR(mp.rate_spread, mp.change_rate) as spread_correlation,
    MIN(mp.change_rate) as worst_daily_return,
    MAX(mp.change_rate) as best_daily_return
FROM market_performance mp
WHERE mp.fed_rate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY mp.exchange
ORDER BY avg_1m_return DESC;

WITH yield_curve_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fff.date,
        fff.value as fed_funds_rate,
        uty.value as treasury_10y,
        uty.value - fff.value as yield_spread
    FROM us_fed_funds_rate fff
    INNER JOIN us_treasury_yield uty ON fff.date = uty.date
    WHERE uty.name LIKE '%10-Year%'
      AND fff.date >= '2021-01-01'
      AND uty.value < fff.value  -- Inverted yield curve
), vix_levels AS (
    SELECT 
        date,
        value as vix_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN value < 20 THEN '저변동성'
            WHEN value >= 20 AND value < 30 THEN '중변동성'
            ELSE '고변동성'
        END as vix_regime
    FROM us_vix
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01'
), sector_classification AS (
    SELECT 
        sector,
        CASE 
            WHEN sector IN ('Utilities', 'Consumer Staples', 'Healthcare', 'Real Estate') THEN '경기방어주'
            WHEN sector IN ('Technology', 'Consumer Discretionary', 'Industrials', 'Materials', 'Energy') THEN '경기순환주'
            ELSE '기타'
        END as sector_type
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT sector 
        FROM us_sector_benchmarks
        WHERE sector IS NOT NULL
    ) s
), inversion_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        usb.date,
        usb.sector,
        sc.sector_type,
        vl.vix_regime,
        usb.pe_median,
        usb.forward_pe_median,
        usb.ev_ebitda_median,
        usb.roe_median,
        usb.return_3m_median,
        ycd.yield_spread
    FROM us_sector_benchmarks usb
    INNER JOIN yield_curve_data ycd ON usb.date = ycd.date
    INNER JOIN vix_levels vl ON usb.date = vl.date
    INNER JOIN sector_classification sc ON usb.sector = sc.sector
    WHERE usb.pe_median IS NOT NULL 
      AND usb.ev_ebitda_median IS NOT NULL
      AND sc.sector_type != '기타'
), sector_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        sector_type,
        vix_regime,
        COUNT(*) as observations,
        AVG(pe_median) as avg_pe,
        AVG(forward_pe_median) as avg_forward_pe,
        AVG(ev_ebitda_median) as avg_ev_ebitda,
        AVG(roe_median) as avg_roe,
        AVG(return_3m_median) as avg_3m_return,
        STDDEV(return_3m_median) as return_volatility,
        AVG(yield_spread) as avg_yield_spread
    FROM inversion_periods
    GROUP BY sector_type, vix_regime
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
), relative_valuation AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.*,
        sa.avg_pe - AVG(sa.avg_pe) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.vix_regime) as pe_vs_market,
        sa.avg_ev_ebitda - AVG(sa.avg_ev_ebitda) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.vix_regime) as ev_ebitda_vs_market,
        sa.avg_3m_return / NULLIF(sa.return_volatility, 0) as risk_adjusted_return
    FROM sector_analysis sa
)
SELECT 
    sector_type,
    vix_regime,
    observations,
    ROUND(avg_pe, 1) as avg_pe_ratio,
    ROUND(avg_forward_pe, 1) as avg_forward_pe,
    ROUND(avg_ev_ebitda, 1) as avg_ev_ebitda,
    ROUND(pe_vs_market, 1) as pe_premium_discount,
    ROUND(ev_ebitda_vs_market, 1) as ev_ebitda_premium_discount,
    ROUND(avg_roe, 1) as avg_roe_pct,
    ROUND(avg_3m_return, 2) as avg_3m_return_pct,
    ROUND(return_volatility, 2) as return_volatility,
    ROUND(risk_adjusted_return, 3) as risk_adjusted_return,
    ROUND(avg_yield_spread, 2) as avg_inversion_spread,
    CASE 
        WHEN pe_vs_market < -2 AND avg_3m_return > 0 THEN '할인 매력도 높음'
        WHEN pe_vs_market > 2 AND avg_3m_return < -2 THEN '프리미엄 부담'
        WHEN risk_adjusted_return > 0.5 THEN '위험조정수익률 양호'
        ELSE '중립'
    END as investment_attractiveness,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY vix_regime ORDER BY risk_adjusted_return DESC) as sector_rank_by_vix
FROM relative_valuation
ORDER BY vix_regime, risk_adjusted_return DESC;

WITH high_inflation_periods AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.date) as month,
    u.value as us_cpi,
    k.data_value as kr_cpi
  FROM us_cpi u
  INNER JOIN bok_economic_indicators k ON DATE_TRUNC('month', u.date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', k.time_value)
  WHERE u.value >= 3.0 
    AND k.data_value >= 3.0
    AND k.stat_name LIKE '%소비자물가지수%'
    AND k.cycle = 'M'
), rate_data AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', f.date) as month,
    AVG(f.value) as us_fed_rate,
    AVG(b.data_value) as kr_base_rate
  FROM us_fed_funds_rate f
  INNER JOIN bok_economic_indicators b ON DATE_TRUNC('month', f.date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', b.time_value)
  WHERE b.stat_name LIKE '%기준금리%'
    AND b.cycle = 'M'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', f.date)
), us_sector_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    h.month,
    s.sector,
    AVG(s.return_1m_median) as avg_monthly_return,
    AVG(s.pe_median) as avg_pe,
    AVG(s.revenue_growth_median) as avg_revenue_growth,
    h.us_cpi,
    h.kr_cpi
  FROM high_inflation_periods h
  INNER JOIN us_sector_benchmarks s ON DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date) = h.month
  GROUP BY h.month, s.sector, h.us_cpi, h.kr_cpi
), market_index_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', m.date) as month,
    m.exchange,
    AVG(m.change_rate) as avg_monthly_return,
    STDDEV(m.change_rate) as monthly_volatility,
    COUNT(*) as trading_days
  FROM market_index m
  WHERE m.exchange IN ('KOSPI', 'NASDAQ')
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', m.date), m.exchange
), combined_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    h.month,
    h.us_cpi,
    h.kr_cpi,
    r.us_fed_rate,
    r.kr_base_rate,
    us.sector,
    us.avg_monthly_return as sector_return,
    us.avg_pe,
    us.avg_revenue_growth,
    k.avg_monthly_return as kospi_return,
    n.avg_monthly_return as nasdaq_return
  FROM high_inflation_periods h
  INNER JOIN rate_data r ON h.month = r.month
  LEFT JOIN us_sector_performance us ON h.month = us.month
  LEFT JOIN market_index_performance k ON h.month = k.month AND k.exchange = 'KOSPI'
  LEFT JOIN market_index_performance n ON h.month = n.month AND n.exchange = 'NASDAQ'
)
SELECT 
  sector,
  COUNT(*) as high_inflation_months,
  ROUND(AVG(sector_return), 2) as avg_sector_return_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(kospi_return), 2) as avg_kospi_return_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(nasdaq_return), 2) as avg_nasdaq_return_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(us_cpi), 2) as avg_us_cpi,
  ROUND(AVG(kr_cpi), 2) as avg_kr_cpi,
  ROUND(AVG(us_fed_rate), 2) as avg_us_fed_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(kr_base_rate), 2) as avg_kr_base_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_pe), 1) as avg_sector_pe,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(sector_return) DESC) as inflation_defense_rank
FROM combined_analysis
WHERE sector IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sector
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY avg_sector_return_pct DESC;

WITH vix_periods AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value as vix_value,
    CASE 
      WHEN value >= 30 THEN 'HIGH_FEAR'
      WHEN value <= 20 THEN 'LOW_FEAR'
      ELSE 'MODERATE'
    END as fear_level
  FROM us_vix
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
sector_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    v.fear_level,
    s.sector,
    AVG(s.return_1m_median) as avg_1m_return,
    AVG(s.return_3m_median) as avg_3m_return,
    STDDEV(s.return_1m_median) as return_volatility,
    COUNT(*) as observation_count
  FROM vix_periods v
  JOIN us_sector_benchmarks s ON s.date = v.date
  WHERE v.fear_level IN ('HIGH_FEAR', 'LOW_FEAR')
  GROUP BY v.fear_level, s.sector
),
fear_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    sector,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fear_level = 'HIGH_FEAR' THEN avg_1m_return END) as high_fear_return,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fear_level = 'LOW_FEAR' THEN avg_1m_return END) as low_fear_return,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fear_level = 'HIGH_FEAR' THEN return_volatility END) as high_fear_vol,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fear_level = 'LOW_FEAR' THEN return_volatility END) as low_fear_vol
  FROM sector_performance
  GROUP BY sector
)
SELECT 
  sector,
  ROUND(high_fear_return::NUMERIC, 2) as high_vix_return,
  ROUND(low_fear_return::NUMERIC, 2) as low_vix_return,
  ROUND((low_fear_return - high_fear_return)::NUMERIC, 2) as return_difference,
  ROUND(high_fear_vol::NUMERIC, 2) as high_vix_volatility,
  ROUND(low_fear_vol::NUMERIC, 2) as low_vix_volatility,
  CASE 
    WHEN high_fear_return > -2 AND high_fear_vol < low_fear_vol THEN 'DEFENSIVE'
    WHEN high_fear_return < -5 OR high_fear_vol > low_fear_vol * 1.5 THEN 'AGGRESSIVE'
    ELSE 'NEUTRAL'
  END as sector_type
FROM fear_comparison
WHERE high_fear_return IS NOT NULL AND low_fear_return IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY return_difference DESC;

WITH fed_rate_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value as fed_rate,
    LAG(value) OVER (ORDER BY date) as prev_fed_rate,
    value - LAG(value) OVER (ORDER BY date) as rate_change
  FROM us_fed_funds_rate
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY date
),
rate_cycles AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    fed_rate,
    rate_change,
    CASE 
      WHEN rate_change > 0.1 THEN 'HIKING'
      WHEN rate_change < -0.1 THEN 'CUTTING'
      WHEN rate_change BETWEEN -0.1 AND 0.1 THEN 'STABLE'
    END as cycle_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rate_change > 0.1 OR rate_change < -0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
      OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cycle_id
  FROM fed_rate_changes
  WHERE rate_change IS NOT NULL
),
market_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    r.cycle_type,
    r.cycle_id,
    m.exchange,
    AVG(m.change_rate) as avg_daily_return,
    STDDEV(m.change_rate) as return_volatility,
    COUNT(*) as trading_days,
    MIN(r.date) as cycle_start,
    MAX(r.date) as cycle_end
  FROM rate_cycles r
  JOIN market_index m ON m.date BETWEEN r.date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND r.date + INTERVAL '30 days'
  WHERE r.cycle_type IN ('HIKING', 'CUTTING')
    AND m.exchange IN ('KOSPI', 'NASDAQ')
  GROUP BY r.cycle_type, r.cycle_id, m.exchange
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
)
SELECT 
  cycle_type as fed_policy,
  exchange as market_index,
  COUNT(*) as cycle_count,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_daily_return)::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_daily_return_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(return_volatility)::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_volatility_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_daily_return * trading_days)::NUMERIC, 2) as avg_cumulative_return,
  ROUND((AVG(avg_daily_return) / NULLIF(AVG(return_volatility), 0))::NUMERIC, 3) as risk_adjusted_return
FROM market_performance
GROUP BY cycle_type, exchange
ORDER BY cycle_type, exchange;

미국 10년물 국채 수익률과 한국 기준금리의 스프레드가 역전될 때 코스피와 나스닥의 상대적 성과를 분석하고, 스프레드 역전 기간 중 섹터별 방어력을 평가해주세요.

WITH treasury_data AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value as us_10y_yield
  FROM us_treasury_yield
  WHERE name LIKE '%10-Year%' AND value IS NOT NULL
),
bok_rate_data AS (
  SELECT 
    time_value as date,
    data_value as kor_base_rate
  FROM bok_economic_indicators
  WHERE stat_name LIKE '%기준금리%' OR stat_name LIKE '%Base rate%'
    AND data_value IS NOT NULL
),
yield_spread AS (
  SELECT 
    t.date,
    t.us_10y_yield,
    b.kor_base_rate,
    t.us_10y_yield - b.kor_base_rate as yield_spread,
    CASE WHEN t.us_10y_yield - b.kor_base_rate < 0 THEN 'INVERTED' ELSE 'NORMAL' END as spread_regime
  FROM treasury_data t
  JOIN bok_rate_data b ON b.date = (
    SELECT MAX(b2.date) 
    FROM bok_rate_data b2 
    WHERE b2.date <= t.date
  )
),
market_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    y.spread_regime,
    m.exchange,
    AVG(m.change_rate) as avg_return,
    STDDEV(m.change_rate) as volatility,
    COUNT(*) as trading_days,
    MIN(m.change_rate) as min_daily_return,
    MAX(m.change_rate) as max_daily_return
  FROM yield_spread y
  JOIN market_index m ON m.date = y.date
  WHERE m.exchange IN ('KOSPI', 'NASDAQ')
    AND y.yield_spread IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY y.spread_regime, m.exchange
),
sector_defense AS (
  SELECT 
    y.spread_regime,
    s.sector,
    AVG(s.return_1m_median) as avg_sector_return,
    AVG(s.operating_margin_median) as avg_operating_margin,
    AVG(s.roe_median) as avg_roe,
    COUNT(*) as observations
  FROM yield_spread y
  JOIN us_sector_benchmarks s ON s.date = y.date
  WHERE y.spread_regime = 'INVERTED'
  GROUP BY y.spread_regime, s.sector
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT 
  'MARKET_COMPARISON' as analysis_type,
  spread_regime,
  exchange as market_or_sector,
  ROUND(avg_return::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_return_pct,
  ROUND(volatility::NUMERIC, 3) as volatility_pct,
  trading_days as observation_count,
  ROUND((avg_return/NULLIF(volatility,0))::NUMERIC, 3) as sharpe_like_ratio,
  NULL as operating_margin,
  NULL as roe
FROM market_comparison
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'SECTOR_DEFENSE' as analysis_type,
  spread_regime,
  sector as market_or_sector,
  ROUND(avg_sector_return::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_return_pct,
  NULL as volatility_pct,
  observations as observation_count,
  NULL as sharpe_like_ratio,
  ROUND(avg_operating_margin::NUMERIC, 2) as operating_margin,
  ROUND(avg_roe::NUMERIC, 2) as roe
FROM sector_defense
ORDER BY analysis_type, avg_return_pct DESC NULLS LAST;

미국 CPI가 전년 동월 대비 5% 이상 상승한 고인플레이션 기간과 2% 이하인 저인플레이션 기간에서 VIX와 주요 지수의 변동성 패턴을 비교하고, 각 인플레이션 구간별 시장 스트레스 지표를 분석해주세요.

WITH cpi_regimes AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value as cpi_rate,
    CASE 
      WHEN value >= 5.0 THEN 'HIGH_INFLATION'
      WHEN value <= 2.0 THEN 'LOW_INFLATION'
      ELSE 'MODERATE_INFLATION'
    END as inflation_regime
  FROM us_cpi
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
vix_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    c.inflation_regime,
    v.date,
    v.value as vix_level,
    CASE 
      WHEN v.value >= 30 THEN 'EXTREME_FEAR'
      WHEN v.value >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_FEAR'
      ELSE 'LOW_FEAR'
    END as fear_level
  FROM cpi_regimes c
  JOIN us_vix v ON v.date BETWEEN c.date - INTERVAL '15 days' AND c.date + INTERVAL '15 days'
  WHERE c.inflation_regime IN ('HIGH_INFLATION', 'LOW_INFLATION')
),
market_volatility AS (
  SELECT 
    c.inflation_regime,
    m.exchange,
    m.date,
    ABS(m.change_rate) as daily_volatility,
    m.change_rate
  FROM cpi_regimes c
  JOIN market_index m ON m.date BETWEEN c.date - INTERVAL '15 days' AND c.date + INTERVAL '15 days'
  WHERE c.inflation_regime IN ('HIGH_INFLATION', 'LOW_INFLATION')
    AND m.exchange IN ('KOSPI', 'NASDAQ', 'NYSE')
),
stress_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    v.inflation_regime,
    AVG(v.vix_level) as avg_vix,
    STDDEV(v.vix_level) as vix_volatility,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.fear_level = 'EXTREME_FEAR' THEN 1 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) * 100 as extreme_fear_pct,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.fear_level = 'HIGH_FEAR' THEN 1 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) * 100 as high_fear_pct
  FROM vix_analysis v
  GROUP BY v.inflation_regime
),
market_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.inflation_regime,
    m.exchange,
    AVG(m.daily_volatility) as avg_volatility,
    STDDEV(m.daily_volatility) as volatility_of_volatility,
    AVG(m.change_rate) as avg_return,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.change_rate < -2 THEN 1 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) * 100 as sharp_decline_pct,
    MIN(m.change_rate) as worst_daily_return,
    MAX(m.change_rate) as best_daily_return
  FROM market_volatility m
  GROUP BY m.inflation_regime, m.exchange
)
SELECT 
  s.inflation_regime,
  'VIX_STRESS_METRICS' as metric_type,
  NULL as exchange,
  ROUND(s.avg_vix::NUMERIC, 2) as avg_value,
  ROUND(s.vix_volatility::NUMERIC, 2) as volatility,
  ROUND(s.extreme_fear_pct::NUMERIC, 1) as extreme_stress_pct,
  ROUND(s.high_fear_pct::NUMERIC, 1) as high_stress_pct,
  NULL as avg_return,
  NULL as worst_return
FROM stress_metrics s
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  m.inflation_regime,
  'MARKET_VOLATILITY' as metric_type,
  m.exchange,
  ROUND(m.avg_volatility::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_value,
  ROUND(m.volatility_of_volatility::NUMERIC, 3) as volatility,
  ROUND(m.sharp_decline_pct::NUMERIC, 1) as extreme_stress_pct,
  NULL as high_stress_pct,
  ROUND(m.avg_return::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_return,
  ROUND(m.worst_daily_return::NUMERIC, 2) as worst_return
FROM market_stats m
ORDER BY inflation_regime, metric_type, exchange NULLS FIRST;

한국의 경제심리지수와 소비심리지수가 기준치(100) 대비 크게 하락한 기간에 코스피 섹터별 벤치마크 대비 상대 성과를 분석하고, 경기 침체 우려 시기의 업종별 방어력을 평가해주세요.

WITH sentiment_indicators AS (
  SELECT 
    time_value as date,
    stat_name,
    data_value
  FROM bok_economic_indicators
  WHERE (stat_name LIKE '%경제심리%' OR stat_name LIKE '%소비심리%' 
         OR stat_name LIKE '%Economic Sentiment%' OR stat_name LIKE '%Consumer%')
    AND data_value IS NOT NULL
),
sentiment_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    AVG(CASE WHEN stat_name LIKE '%경제심리%' OR stat_name LIKE '%Economic Sentiment%' 
             THEN data_value END) as economic_sentiment,
    AVG(CASE WHEN stat_name LIKE '%소비심리%' OR stat_name LIKE '%Consumer%' 
             THEN data_value END) as consumer_sentiment
  FROM sentiment_indicators
  GROUP BY date
  HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN stat_name LIKE '%경제심리%' OR stat_name LIKE '%Economic Sentiment%' 
                  THEN data_value END) IS NOT NULL
     OR AVG(CASE WHEN stat_name LIKE '%소비심리%' OR stat_name LIKE '%Consumer%' 
                THEN data_value END) IS NOT NULL
),
recession_fear_periods AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    economic_sentiment,
    consumer_sentiment,
    CASE 
      WHEN economic_sentiment < 85 OR consumer_sentiment < 85 THEN 'HIGH_PESSIMISM'
      WHEN economic_sentiment > 110 OR consumer_sentiment > 110 THEN 'HIGH_OPTIMISM'
      ELSE 'NEUTRAL'
    END as sentiment_regime
  FROM sentiment_analysis
  WHERE economic_sentiment IS NOT NULL OR consumer_sentiment IS NOT NULL
),
kospi_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    r.sentiment_regime,
    m.date,
    m.change_rate as kospi_return,
    AVG(m.change_rate) OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.sentiment_regime 
      ORDER BY m.date 
      ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as rolling_avg_return
  FROM recession_fear_periods r
  JOIN market_index m ON m.date BETWEEN r.date - INTERVAL '7 days' AND r.date + INTERVAL '7 days'
  WHERE m.exchange = 'KOSPI'
    AND r.sentiment_regime IN ('HIGH_PESSIMISM', 'HIGH_OPTIMISM')
),
us_sector_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    r.sentiment_regime,
    s.sector,
    AVG(s.return_1m_median) as avg_sector_return,
    AVG(s.return_3m_median) as avg_3m_return,
    AVG(s.pe_median) as avg_pe,
    AVG(s.operating_margin_median) as avg_operating_margin,
    AVG(s.roe_median) as avg_roe,
    STDDEV(s.return_1m_median) as return_volatility,
    COUNT(*) as observation_count
  FROM recession_fear_periods r
  JOIN us_sector_benchmarks s ON s.date BETWEEN r.date - INTERVAL '15 days' AND r.date + INTERVAL '15 days'
  WHERE r.sentiment_regime = 'HIGH_PESSIMISM'
  GROUP BY r.sentiment_regime, s.sector
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
sector_defense_ranking AS (
  SELECT 
    sector,
    avg_sector_return,
    avg_3m_return,
    avg_operating_margin,
    avg_roe,
    return_volatility,
    observation_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_sector_return DESC) as return_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_volatility ASC) as stability_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_operating_margin DESC NULLS LAST) as profitability_rank
  FROM us_sector_comparison
)
SELECT 
  'KOSPI_SENTIMENT_IMPACT' as analysis_type,
  sentiment_regime as category,
  NULL as sector,
  COUNT(*) as observation_days,
  ROUND(AVG(kospi_return)::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_return_pct,
  ROUND(STDDEV(kospi_return)::NUMERIC, 3) as volatility_pct,
  NULL as operating_margin,
  NULL as defense_score
FROM kospi_performance
GROUP BY sentiment_regime
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'SECTOR_DEFENSE_RANKING' as analysis_type,
  'HIGH_PESSIMISM' as category,
  sector,
  observation_count as observation_days,
  ROUND(avg_sector_return::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_return_pct,
  ROUND(return_volatility::NUMERIC, 3) as volatility_pct,
  ROUND(avg_operating_margin::NUMERIC, 2) as operating_margin,
  ROUND((return_rank + stability_rank + profitability_rank)::NUMERIC / 3.0, 1) as defense_score
FROM sector_defense_ranking
ORDER BY analysis_type, avg_return_pct DESC NULLS LAST;
